A '''Screening Officer''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial officer/Legends|officer]] stationed at an [[Imperial Recruitment Office]]. They were responsible for screening potential recruits into the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] by performing background checks into a candidate's personal history, education records and home life.<ref name="IS">''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''</ref> Individual branches of the Imperial military had their own Screening Officers; the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] maintained their own officers at recruitment offices, and encouraged potential new recruits to contact them directly if interested in enlisting in the Navy.<ref name="RPG1" />
